positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Expanded public GraphQL API, by handling complex permissioning logic, proxying other teams' internal APIs, and developing error handling architecture
• Built VSCode extension (with 12,887 installs), which provides users with real-time learning recommendations and analytics regarding how they spend their time in various projects and languages
• Improved code design on and expanded Tableau Web Data Connector, which provides enterprise customers easy access to millions of rows of data

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
• Built a GraphQL server in Node.js for a public API with another developer
• Wrote succinct documentation for this public API
• Actively participated in mob programming to improve site communications system

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: • Taught students how to design and analyze algorithms using techniques such as dynamic programming, linear programming, greedy algorithms, divide-and-conquer algorithms, graph algorithms, and intelligent search algorithms.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Wrote Python code that distributes a program's work to over 15 machines, using parallel ssh and mapreduce
• Coded a classifier which assigns labels to documents using word and topic probabilities
• Presented paper about interactive topic modeling during a poster session of the 2018 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
• Wrote code to generate cross-references for Jane Austen's published novels, contributing to a paper accepted by the North American Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics

volunteerExperiences.description: I worked to create political will for carbon fee and dividend legislation. This included building relationships with community leaders, making presentations about the efficacy and importance of climate legislation, and supporting other chapter members in their volunteer efforts.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: BYU Women in Computer Science Club
volunteerExperiences.description:
• Led a team of 6 club officers with the vision of connecting women in computer science to each other and to mentors, enabling them to succeed
• Planned, coordinated, and executed events that fulfilled our mission
• Directly mentored 3 freshmen women in the Computer Science program

company.name: BYU Women in Computer Science Club
